jobs.title: Senior Investment Strategist - Head of Taxable FI (US Retail)
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With:
The Senior Investment Strategist & Head of Taxable Fixed Income US Retail, partners with both the investment team and distribution to promote and drive the growth of the fixed income business for AB. US Retail is an extremely important channel for AB and a key source of growth for our taxable fixed income businesses. This is a senior hire within the Fixed Income Business Development & Product Strategy team who will take responsible for the design and implementation of AB’s business strategy, including the supporting the acquisition and servicing of clients in AB Fixed Income products.

What You’ll Do:
- Provide insights about AB fixed income strategies and capital market developments to existing and prospective clients

- Focus on the positioning, marketing, and servicing for AB’s Taxable fixed income platform in the US retail market, which includes a market leading suite of mutual funds, ETFs and SMAs

- Serve as a spokesperson for the fixed income team at client meetings and events with the ability to demonstrate a deep understanding of AB’s investment process, market outlook, and investment strategies

- Grow and support the fixed income retail (and occasionally institutional) business across in the US in collaboration with AB’s sales force.

- Provide regular updates and training to internal stakeholders on fixed income market developments and portfolio strategies. Serve as a key on-the-ground fixed income resource to answer client questions on specific sales opportunities

- Partner with Product Development on new products (or enhancement of existing products) that are relevant to assigned coverage

- Identify areas for thought leadership that connect with product responsibilities. In partnership with other business development colleagues, continuously create new sales ideas/ways to advocate products (e.g. blog posts, thought leadership ideas)

- Manage, mentor and develop a team of approximately 2 -3 members

What We’re Looking For:
- 10+ years of experience in the investment management industry with direct Investment Strategist / Client Portfolio Manager / Portfolio Specialist experience

- A proven track record of successfully promoting fixed income investment strategies to prospects and clients in US retail channels

- Strong technical knowledge of fixed income markets and macroeconomics trends. Intellectual curiosity about global capital markets and ability to find creative ways to connect with existing and prospective clients

- An understanding of the US retail competitive landscape and buy-side industry trends for fixed income strategies across various channels. Contacts with key product selection decision makers and financial institutions’ intermediaries a plus

- Strong analytical skills, collaborative attitude, sense of ownership, strong prioritization skills and execution skills

- A team player with highly developed interpersonal skills, including collaboration, negotiation, and influence

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Gravitas, ability to present credibly and resonate with clients across a wide range of client segments and settings, going from one-on-one meetings with sophisticated institutional investors to large groups with retail advisors or individual investors.

- Strong marketing and messaging skills in order to maintain a compelling story for AB's fixed income franchise and individual products

- Ability to prospect and close new business relationships in partnership with AB's retail relationship managers, institutional client advisors and global financial institutions team.

- A desire to interact directly with both internal teams and external clients to influence their product knowledge and support AB’s sales efforts.

- Ability to work effectively under pressure while multitasking, adhering to tight deadlines, and maintaining strategic relationships with internal partners

- Experience managing, mentoring and developing junior talent

- Detail-oriented and organized

- Advanced business degree in fields such as Economics/Finance, relevant industry certifications (e.g. CFA, CAIA) a plus

About AB
We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.

Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!

jobs.title: Multi-Sector Insurance Associate Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With:
AllianceBernstein is seeking a Multi-Sector Insurance Associate Portfolio Manager (APM), reporting to the Manager of Multi-Sector Insurance Portfolio Management Group (PMG).  As part of the Portfolio Management Group organization, Multi-Sector Insurance APMs partner directly with Portfolio Management and Trading as well as other areas of the firm including Sales, Operations, Technology, and more.

What You’ll Do:
An APM must ensure accurate and efficient implementation of Insurance trades. Specific responsibilities include:
- Managing portfolio cash balances and ensuring cash balances are consistent with portfolio guidelines and current investment strategy.
- Monitoring portfolio positions, trade orders and analytics for compliance with client guidelines and adherence to asset allocation, duration, and risk targets.
- Highlighting deviations from targets and recommending trades to rebalance portfolios.
- Generating purchase or sell orders to manage client cash flows, FX rebalances and active investments.
- Facilitating account opening/closings and liaising with Sales and Portfolio Management to address ad-hoc client requests.
- Assisting with preparation of investment and portfolio exposure reports.
- Reviewing proposed guideline amendments, custodial changes and other activities that may impact accounts.
- Identifying opportunities and partnering with technologists to re-engineer and automate processes to increase operational efficiency, improve client service and enhance risk controls.
- Providing support to Portfolio Managers, Sales, Trading and Operations to deliver against client requirements.
- Partner with Insurance Ops in portfolio transfers and determine actionable cash balance.
- Build and maintain investment program trackers and report-out presentations.
- Serve as Clients’ first go-to on asset class related inquiries and provide impairment review support.
- Perform bespoke analysis on asset allocation and provide insurance specific relative value recommendations.

What We’re Looking For:
- Candidates must have outstanding attention to detail, coupled with a proven ability to think logically and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment, often under time pressure and across multiple tasks.
- A bachelor’s degree with three to five years of industry-related experience.
- Experience with Fixed Income credit, currency and/or global markets is preferred.
- Motivated self-starter with a passion for process improvement and leveraging technology to solve complex business problems.
- Strong interest/experience in financial markets, notably insurance asset management.
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Effective communication skills paired with a strong desire to work in a team-oriented organization.
- Exceptional understanding of risk management and overall control environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
- Strong soft skills such as adaptability and creativity.
- Coding and AI experience or use of data visualization tools is beneficial.

jobs.title: Quant Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
AB’s Systematic Equity strategy sits within Multi-Asset & Hedge Fund Solutions, a team recognized for combining quantitative rigor with deep market expertise. You will report directly to the Head Portfolio Manager in New York and work in close partnership with AB’s technology and data engineering teams, who provide robust infrastructure and tooling—enabling you to focus on research, signal development, and investment decision-making.

You will also interact directly with AB’s institutional clients and prospects, representing the strategy in meetings and contributing to business development efforts.
What You'll Do

Systematic Research & Signal Development
- Monitor, validate, and continuously refine the suite of active systematic signals.
- Design, implement, and maintain quantitative models and signals to identify alpha opportunities and to assess portfolio-level risk/return dynamics.
- Generate, backtest, and rigorously evaluate new investment hypotheses using the team’s backtesting platform; ensure the integrity of the underlying inputs by enforcing completeness, accuracy, and consistency across historical and live datasets.
- Apply machine learning and advanced statistical methods to extract predictive signals from deal, market, and alternative data sources.
- Proactively identify and execute opportunities to deploy AI tools to improve research productivity, signal discovery, and the overall investment process.

Portfolio Management Support
- Rebalance the portfolio to align with target weights.
- Work closely with trading team to execute orders.
- Work with Compliance on regulatory considerations.
- Consolidate PnL and portfolio attributions.
- Work with the NY PM team to ensure your process is aligned with current requirements and use cases.

Technology & Data
- Partner with AB’s technology team to enhance research workflows, data pipelines, signal construction, and analytics.
- Identify and prioritize opportunities to expand the team’s data capabilities by sourcing, evaluating, and integrating relevant alternative and third‑party datasets.

Client & Business Development
- Attend meetings with institutional clients and prospects to present the strategy, review current portfolio positioning, and share research insights and findings.
- Contribute to the preparation of investor materials, performance commentary, and research publications.
- Serve as a credible, articulate representative of the strategy in client engagements and external forums.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications
- 3-5 years of investment management experience with direct, hands-on quantitative equity exposure for Taiwan stock market.
- Possess Taiwan license for SITCA registration.
- Proficient in Python and MATLAB for research and data analysis; able to write and maintain production-quality code in an investment environment.
- Proficient in SQL for querying and managing structured datasets.
- Demonstrated experience in quantitative research, including systematic strategy backtesting and signal performance evaluation.
- Excellent attention to detail with a strong commitment to data quality and robust research practices.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to present investment views clearly and credibly to sophisticated institutional audiences.
- Bachelor’s degree in quantitative or finance-related discipline (e.g., Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or similar).
- Deep knowledge of the Taiwan equity market. Knowledge of Taiwan equities market microstructure, index futures and index options are plus.

Preferred
- Experience with quantitative modeling techniques and machine learning methods.
- Exposure to systematic investment strategy development, including factor construction, signal aggregation/combination, and portfolio optimization.

Taipei City, Taiwan

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Investment Operations & Asset Management
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With:
The Senior Associate, Investment Operations & Asset Management role is a great opportunity for a qualified candidate looking for a dynamic operations role focused on commercial real estate transaction. This role is part of the Operations organization and is focused on transaction execution, coordination, reporting, and asset management support rather than investment origination or investment decision making. The Senior Associate will partner closely with the front office commercial team and support the full lifecycle of commercial real estate transactions plus will have responsibility for coordinating asset management of the team’s investments. They will be exposed to all features of AB CarVal’s commercial real estate business, will be responsible for several aspects of new and existing transactions, and will work closely with a wide variety of parties both within AB CarVal and externally.

This role reports into the Head of U.S. Operations. The role will be located in New York, NY or Minneapolis, MN.

What You’ll Do:
Asset Management - (50%)
- Coordinate and support the management of third-party commercial real estate relationships

- Coordinate and project manage workstreams on the commercial real estate projects with third party asset managers, supporting execution of approved asset business plans’

- Track and report asset performance against underwriting and business plan metrics

- Liaise with property managers, brokers, and service providers to ensure operational efficiency

- Coordinate documentation, tracking, and execution support related to loan modifications and borrower communications.

- Ensure timely communication and coordination with the commercial team decision makers regarding project execution and operational matters

- Support implementation and tracking of approved asset-level strategies

- Ensure proper portfolio reporting/review and communication with key internal and external stakeholders connected to the projects

- Act as the primary source of information internally for investment transaction performance and asset-related updates
- Prepare regular asset performance reports, including variance analysis

- Monitor borrower compliance with loan documentation and business plans and further investigate any issues that may arise

- Escalate issues and coordinate resolution across stakeholders, proactively focusing on the most material/financially impactful areas and ensuring quick response to any ad hoc issues

- Support the commercial real estate commercial team to ensure they have the information required to maintain accurate detailed financial models (incl. monthly valuations) for the projects

- Coordinate operational workstreams related to new warehouse facilities and loan onboarding
- Serve as an operational coordination contact for financing counterparties

- Prepare and maintain investment memorandums, reports, and presentations for internal committees

- Manage legal, finance, and tax related tasks associated with each investment transaction or the commercial real estate strategy

Operational Management - (25%)
- Provide day-to-day operational input on commercial real estate investment transactions

- Support operational due diligence, transaction coordination, and information gathering related to acquisitions.

- Coordinate closing processes with legal, finance, and external stakeholders

- Engage with and interpret detailed commercial real estate investment transaction legal documents

- Track and reconcile investment-level cash flows, budgets, and funding requirements.

- Quickly evaluate complex situations that arise and use good judgement to propose solutions

- Effectively manage be-spoke complex financing agreements

- Set up new deal structures and manage existing deal structures with various AB CarVal departments as well as external stakeholders

- Complete due diligence and audit requests by working with appropriate partners

- Coordinate, manage and maintain accuracy all aspects of tracking commercial real estate transactions in AB CarVal’s systems

- Respond to internal and external queries regarding commercial real estate investment transactions throughout their life cycle

Business Partnering - (25%)
- Collaborate with the AB CarVal commercial real estate commercial team and external commercial real estate transaction partners

- Provide input on commercial real estate investment transaction documentation alongside AB CarVal commercial real estate commercial team

- Coordinate with partners regarding appropriate investment memorandums, performance reporting, business & legal practices, and accounting procedures for each investment transaction

- Make judgement-based decisions related to the operations function and assume responsibility for the impact to the business

- Understand key areas of the commercial real estate investment transactions/business and anticipate potential issues; proactively communicate solutions to others within the team or management

- Assist with project by project review/analysis/milestones within commercial real estate investment transactions

What We’re Looking For:
Required:
- Bachelor's degree in accounting, business, finance, or related industry

- 5+ years finance experience

- Demonstrated experience in and/or exposure to commercial real estate asset management/portfolio operations preferably including underwriting, credit evaluation, and third party relationship management

- Advanced Excel skills including data modelling and analysis

- Strong communicator who can coordinate and support collaboration across technical, legal, construction, and financial teams

- Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with various teams and portfolio companies

- Demonstrates knowledge and mechanics of lending instruments, legal documents and structures

- Strong work ethic and commitment to a high standard of excellence

- Proven ability to balance multiple assignments and manage quality, accuracy, and consistency of each work product

- A self-starter with the ability to follow through and complete tasks

- High level verbal and written communication skills

- Strong drive for results with both detailed and practical focus

- Strong analytical/problem solving skills

- Enjoys working in a collaborative team environment, partnering with commercial team

- Ability to travel, including for site visits and portfolio company meetings as needed

Preferred:
- Experience with commercial real estate investments, transactions, asset management terms and concepts

- Experience working in an alternative investment fund manager or similar industry

- Public accounting or financial services experience

- Demonstrated initiative in communicating issues and concepts to multiple groups at multiple levels

- Knowledge and/or experience with conducting audits and due diligence of external companies

Who We Are:
AB CarVal is an established global alternative investment manager and part of AllianceBernstein’s Private Alternatives business. Since 1987, AB CarVal’s team has navigated through ever-changing credit market cycles, investing $160 billion in 5,885 transactions across 82 countries. Today, AB CarVal has approximately $21 billion in assets under management. The firm has a 39-year history, strong track record and an established reputation in asset-based finance with a team of approximately 75 investment professionals in the US, Europe and Asia. A key differentiator is the firm’s robust global network of established relationships with operating platforms and partners.
AB CarVal Investors is established in managing opportunistic global real estate investments in both commercial and residential real estate transactions, as well as real estate-related public debt. AB CarVal’s flexible mandate has enabled it to be a provider of capital on transitional assets, construction, and value-add transactions across property types. The commercial real estate debt team is responsible for a portfolio of approximately $2 billion of assets under management.  The debt strategy is primarily focused on bridge/construction lending and trading SASB CMBS bonds. With each investment opportunity, AB CarVal applies an in-depth, bottom-up underwriting process focused on underlying business plans and market fundamentals. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.
In accordance with applicable law, the minimum and maximum base annual salary for this role is as follows:
Base Salary Range: $130,000 to $160,000

Actual base salaries may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, past performance, and other job-related factors. Base salary is just one component of total compensation at AB CarVal, which may include, depending on eligibility, commissions, year-end incentive compensation, short- and long-term incentives and Department-specific awards. In addition AB provides a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, sick and vacation time off

Who You’ll Work With:

What You’ll Do:
Private Account Management  Investment Management
- Take charge of managing absolute return-oriented fixed income or multi-asset discretionary accounts (including insurance outsourced mandates, bank proprietary/wealth subsidiary outsourced mandates, enterprise annuities, family trusts, etc.), formulate and execute investment strategies, and hold primary responsibility for portfolio performance, drawdown control and risk management.

jobs.title: Investment Management Operations Transformation Analyst
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With:
Investment Management Operations plays a critical role in supporting AllianceBernstein's global investment platform and delivering exceptional outcomes for our Institutional, Retail, Insurance, and Strategic Business Unit clients.

The organization is responsible for the operational processes, controls, and infrastructure that support the full investment lifecycle across multiple asset classes and investment strategies. Our teams partner closely with Investment Professionals, Technology, Risk and Client Groups to ensure investment activities are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with regulatory and client requirements.

What You'll Do:
We are seeking a Nashville based Investment Management Operations Transformation Analyst to join Investment Management Operations in Global Technology & Operations.

Investment Management Operations is currently leading a multi-year transformation initiative focused on modernizing and simplifying the firm's operating model through the implementation of SimCorp. This strategic program will consolidate legacy platforms, standardize business processes, improve data quality, strengthen operational controls, and enhance scalability across the organization.

This role will partner directly with operational teams, technology partners, and project stakeholders to support the analysis, design, testing, validation, and implementation of future-state business processes as AllianceBernstein modernizes its operating platform.

Transformation Analysts serve as embedded business partners within specific operational disciplines and play a key role in ensuring business requirements are understood, solutions are validated, and operational readiness is achieved throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Successful candidates will initially support a designated operational workstream and may have opportunities to rotate across additional business functions as implementation phases are completed. This rotational model provides broad exposure to the investment management lifecycle while offering the opportunity to contribute to one of the firm's most significant strategic initiatives.

This role spans a broad range of functions including:
- Pre- and post-trade compliance

- Trade support, confirmation, and settlement

- Reconciliation and operational controls

- Security reference data management

- Pricing and valuation operations

- Corporate actions processing

- Performance measurement and attribution

- Client and regulatory reporting

- Collaborate with subject matter experts to document business requirements, process flows, procedures, and operating controls.

- Create, execute, and maintain test scenarios, test scripts, and validation plans to support system implementation and business readiness activities.

- Perform end-to-end business process validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements and operational expectations.

- Identify, document, track, and assist in the resolution of defects, business exceptions, and process gaps throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Validate data conversions, system integrations, reporting outputs, and operational workflows between legacy platforms and SimCorp.

- Participate in project working groups, requirements workshops, testing forums, and defect triage meetings.

- Support change management and operational readiness activities, including training, procedure development, and knowledge transfer.

- Maintain project documentation, action logs, issue trackers, and implementation artifacts to support program governance.

- Analyze operational impacts of system and process changes and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, control, and risk management.

- Partner with operational teams across pre- and post-trade compliance, trade confirmation, trade settlement, reconciliation, security reference data management, pricing, corporate actions, performance and attribution, and client reporting to support implementation activities and business transformation initiatives.

What We're Looking For:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or related field.

- 3+ years of experience within investment management, asset servicing, investment operations, consulting, business analysis, or financial technology.

- Experience in one or more investment operations disciplines, including: Trade Support and Settlements, Trade Confirmation, Investment Compliance, Security Master and Reference Data, Reconciliation and Control, Pricing Operations, Performance and Attribution, Corporate Actions, and Client Reporting

- Experience creating business requirements, test cases, process flows, or operating procedures.

- Knowledge of investment management workflows and investment products.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

- Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn new business functions.

- Ability to build effective relationships across business and technology teams.

About AB
We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.

Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!

All are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law.  AB’s policies and practices seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants based solely on job-related criteria .

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Role Overview:
We are seeking a creative and agile marketing specialist , who can transform market trends and AB’s investment insights into engaging, investor-friendly stories. This role focuses on conceptualizing, producing, and executing multimedia content—from articles and infographics to short videos and animations—while supporting the team in driving product visibility and sales impact.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead writing: Develop content angles and outlines; write clear, investor-friendly articles, briefs, and explainers in Mandarin (and English) that translate AB’s investment insights into messages that resonate with Taiwan investors.
- Scriptwriting & multimedia storytelling: Plan and script videos, shorts, and animations with compelling hooks, narratives, and CTAs tailored for social and distributor channels.
- Interview & translate into stories: Conduct interviews with AB portfolio managers, business leads, and product specialists or utilize existing group resources to create timely, insightful local content that closely aligns with Taiwan’s business focus.
- AI-assisted multimedia production: Capable of utilizing the group approved AI tools and video-editing software to efficiently produce and edit short videos. Support integrated product campaigns with creative content and ensure alignment across platforms. Manage compliance review and production timelines for all multimedia deliverables.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Marketing, Finance or related field.
- 5~10 years of experience as a financial journalist, editor, marketing specialist in Finance, or multimedia producer preferred.
- Certified Securities Investment Trust and Consulting Professional (投信投顧業務員證照) or Certified Securities Specialist (證券商高級業務員證照)
- Strong writing and storytelling skills, capable of simplifying complex investment topics.
- Experience in content planning, video scripting, and vendor coordination. Familiar with video editing tools such as PlayPlay, Heygen etc.
- Ability to deliver high-quality content under tight deadlines. Familiarity with digital platforms and social media content formats.
- Fluent in Mandarin and English

Key Attributes:
• Strong editorial judgment and curiosity about market dynamics.
• Able to translate technical investment insights into relatable investor stories.
• Hands-on, creative, and detail-oriented.
• Collaborative team player with initiative and ownership.

Taipei City, Taiwan
